source: Local Windows developer verification; workbook generated by xlflow, loaded and saved by real Microsoft Excel after Main.Run passed.

office.provenance: Reported by the local runtime verification coordinator. No Excel was started during fixture extraction or pure-Go regression tests.

fixture.source_formatting_note: Committed JSON sources were formatted without changing parsed values; capture hashes identify the original verification bytes. The Excel-saved binary is unchanged.

runtime_observation.assertions: Approximately 130 actual runtime assertions across all applicable properties of the Form and 15 built-in control types, plus loaded BMP presence.
regressions: TextProps FontEffects bit0 alone loaded Bold=False with default FontWeight400; explicit FontWeight700 is required for Bold=True.
MultiPage Font, ForeColor and BackColor are persisted by its hidden TabStrip rather than the enclosing FormStream.
Page Font, ForeColor, BackColor and BorderStyle, and CommandButton TextAlign, returned runtime error438 and are excluded from the authoring contract.

workflow.note: Commands describe the coordinator's verified session workflow; run xlflow commands from the disposable project. Source staging copies generation-source.json to src/forms/specs/TypedProperties.json, adds its BMP asset and installs the assertion macro before push.

limitations: This is Excel-saved runtime evidence from one local Office16.0 x64 installation, not an independently authored VBE layout fixture or a cross-version guarantee.

Excel omits several default-valued properties, including root system colors and Image BorderStyle. Tests retain omission and compare confirmed effective values without materializing defaults into the source.
Pure-Go tests validate committed bytes only; they do not open Excel or claim a new runtime observation.
